patterns.what_was_hard: Warrior family-conditional sets cannot branch in a static table; shipped the documented union as provisional with rationale. Rogue R-T3 keys have no widgets/defaults; template still writes them nil-safely and the suite pins the exemption list.
patterns.what_worked: Derived-state dirty-detect (get compares db vs stored template) needed no setter changes; existing HUD tick picks up db writes so no hud.lua edit.
